Abdulelah Al-Amri.note: Al-Amri stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Abdulelah Al-Amri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Abdullah Al-Hamdan.note: Al-Hamdan's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Abdullah Al-Khaibari.note: Al-Khaibari stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ahmed Al-Kassar.summary: Ahmed Al-Kassar is a Saudi Arabia goalkeeper from Al-Qadsiah who brings experience, reaction saves, and penalty-area control.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.note: Al-Kassar stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Alaa Hejji.summary: Alaa Hejji is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from NEOM SC who helps connect possession and support counter-pressing phases.
Alaa Hejji.note: Hejji is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Alaa Hejji.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ali Lajami.note: Watch Lajami for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ali Lajami.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Ali Majrashi.note: Majrashi stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ali Majrashi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Ayman Yahya.note: Yahya stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ayman Yahya.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Firas Al-Buraikan.note: Al-Buraikan stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Firas Al-Buraikan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Hassan Al-Tambakti.note: Al-Tambakti is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Hassan Kadesh.summary: Hassan Kadesh is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Ittihad who gives the team left-footed balance, defensive experience, and set-piece presence.
Hassan Kadesh.note: Watch Kadesh for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Hassan Kadesh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jehad Thakri.summary: Jehad Thakri is a Saudi Arabia centre-back from Al-Qadsiah who adds size, aerial defending, and squad depth.
Jehad Thakri.note: Watch Thakri for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Jehad Thakri.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Khalid Al-Ghannam.note: Al-Ghannam's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Mohamed Kanno.note: Kanno's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Mohamed Kanno.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.summary: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Qadsiah who offers recovery speed, overlap timing, and defensive energy.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.note: Al-Shamat stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.noteZh: 他的突出特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Mohammed Al-Owais.note: Al-Owais is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mohammed Al-Owais.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Moteb Al-Harbi.summary: Moteb Al-Harbi is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Hilal who brings overlap timing, recovery defending, and left-footed service.
Moteb Al-Harbi.note: Al-Harbi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Moteb Al-Harbi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在从后场加入进攻的启动时机上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Musab Al-Juwayr.note: Al-Juwayr is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Musab Al-Juwayr.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Nasser Al-Dawsari.summary: Nasser Al-Dawsari is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from Al-Hilal who adds coverage, passing discipline, and late shooting threat.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.note: Watch Al-Dawsari for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Nawaf Al-Aqidi.note: Al-Aqidi's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Nawaf Al-Aqidi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Nawaf Boushal.summary: Nawaf Boushal is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Nassr who brings overlap energy, recovery speed, and wide defensive bite.
Nawaf Boushal.note: Boushal's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Nawaf Boushal.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Saleh Al-Shehri.note: Al-Shehri's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Saleh Al-Shehri.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Salem Al-Dawsari.note: Al-Dawsari stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Salem Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Saud Abdulhamid.note: Abdulhamid's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Saud Abdulhamid.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Sultan Mandash.note: Mandash is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Sultan Mandash.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Ziyad Al-Johani.summary: Ziyad Al-Johani is a Saudi Arabia defensive midfielder from Al-Ahli who adds ball winning, central coverage, and short progression.
Ziyad Al-Johani.note: Al-Johani's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ziyad Al-Johani.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
